items.t: How Many Shares of Realty Income, Simon Property or NNN REIT Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $195,000 of NNN REIT, $213,600 of Realty Income or $292,800 of Simon Property Group. NNN REIT’s dividend is both the cheapest to fund and the best covered, which makes it my pick for a retiree.
